'''Greel wood''' was a dark [[Color/Legends|scarlet]] [[Wood/Legends|wood]] harvested from the [[greel tree]]s native to the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Pii III]] and [[Pii IV]] in the [[Pii system/Legends|Pii system]]. It was favored as a luxury item throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] owing its color and rarity.

==History==
During the final [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], entrepreneur [[Meysen Kayson]] bought the rights to develop [[Pii III]] and [[Pii IV]] as a bi-[[Planet/Legends|planetary]] nature reserve. While clearing space for the first buildings, a species of greel tree was discovered. Although the bark was rough and of no use, the [[Wood/Legends|wood]] below was found to be smooth and a deep scarlet-violet in color. After consultation with [[xenobotanist]]s and [[xenoarborist]]s, Kayson found that the specific species had an amazing fast growth rate; if the stump was left intact, it would grow back to its original height within five [[Standard year/Legends|years]]. Kayson abandoned his plans for the nature reserve and established the [[Greel Wood Logging Corporation]]. By instituting a careful program of logging and allowing harvested trees time to regenerate, Kayson laid the foundation for a successful company.<ref name="GWH" />

The Greel Wood Logging Corporation was responsible for harvesting greel wood from the worlds of Pii III and Pii IV in the [[Arkanis sector/Legends|Arkanis sector]].<ref name="GWH" /><ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> Greel trees were harvested on both Pii III and Pii IV, and the differences in the planetary weather conditions led to planet produce a different variety of greel wood. Pii III's greel wood was known as the "grassland scarlet greel wood." The greel wood from Pii IV was known as the "band crimson greel wood." The bushland scarlet was bushier, denser, and lighter in color. The band crimson was lighter, but darker in color. It commanded a higher price due to the elaborate and ornate spirals, waves and bands in the near-black flaws.<ref name="GWH" />

With [[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton]], the Greel Wood Logging Corporation developed the [[FLR-series Logger Droid|FLR "Lumberdroid"]] for its tree-felling operations.<ref name="Droids">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>

As a teenager, [[Tirs Maladane]] spent a summer on Pii III working in the greel wood industry to earn some [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|money]].<ref name="Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

==Uses==
Some models of [[groundcoach]]<ref name="HSLL" /> including the [[Ubrikkian Transports/Legends|Ubrikkian Transports]] [[LuxurPort Zisparanza]],<ref name="HSCS">''[[Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook]]''</ref> utilized greel wood in both interior and exterior paneling.<ref name="HSLL" /> Greel wood was also used in the construction of furniture, high-end jewelry, and ornamental products.<ref name="GSWU" /> The walls of the [[Aspre Plunge]] [[Casino/Legends|casino]] were paneled in highly polished greel wood,<ref name="SR">{{JournalCite|1|The Spira Regatta}}</ref> as were the luxurious [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] rooms of the [[Submarine/Legends|undersea]] passenger liner ''[[Coral Vanda]]''.<ref name="Vehicles and Vessels">''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref> The first [[R-10 household droid]]s that were produced for use in the pleasure palaces on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Hesperidium/Legends|Hesperidium]] were decorated with polished greel-wood panels.<ref name="Droids" />

Greel wood was used in furniture and in some [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] hilts. [[Darth Vader's Palace]] contained spartan chairs and tables made from greel wood. [[Platt Okeefe/Legends|Platt Okeefe]] had a greel wood wardrobe onboard her ship, the [[Last Chance (YT-1300 light freighter)/Legends|Last Chance]]. The [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Akris Ur'etu]] had a desk made from Greel wood inside one of his [[Skar'kla Consortium]] bases. [[Pok Nar-Ten]] of the [[Klatooinian Trade Guild/Legends|Klatooinian Trade Guild]] had furniture made of Greel wood.
